description: This file contains the implementation of the IPTestAdministrator class, which manages inter-process communication and synchronization for unit tests involving multiple processes. It includes methods for synchronization, process identification, and timed locking/waiting mechanisms, and references external system and core headers.

classes.name: IPTestAdministrator
classes.description: A class that manages inter-process synchronization and communication for unit testing, using shared memory, mutexes, and condition variables.

methods.name: IPTestAdministrator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes shared data, sets up synchronization primitives, and forks a child process to run the provided main function.

methods.name: ~IPTestAdministrator
methods.description: Destructor that waits for the child process to finish.

methods.name: Sync
methods.description: Performs synchronization between parent and child processes using shared memory, mutexes, and condition variables, returning whether the messages match.

methods.name: GetProcessName
methods.description: Returns a string indicating whether the current process is the parent or the child.

methods.name: TimedLock
methods.description: Attempts to lock a mutex with a timeout, aborting if the timeout expires.

methods.name: TimedWait
methods.description: Waits on a condition variable with a timeout, aborting if the timeout expires.

methods.name: FillTimeOut
methods.description: Fills a timespec structure with the current time plus a predefined timeout duration.
